dct_description_sm: This project investigates contemporary landscape hazards related to permafrost degradation in five Yukon communities, and their potential evolution in response to changes. As the stability of infrastructure is related to the stability and bearing capacity of the underlying permafrost, assessing environmental conditions that may be affected by climate and those that pose hazards to safe and sustainable development were mapped to evaluate areas with low to high risk vulnerability. This project will characterize and map surficial geology, permafrost conditions, surficial hydrology; it will identify existing landscape hazards with its potential trajectories of change. It will also assign hazard ranking criteria and incorporate current and future risk levels to landscape units.

dct_title_s: Landscape Hazards in Yukon Communities: Geoscience Mapping for Climate Change Adaptation Planning
